       | {error, atom()}
  spec recv/3 recv(inet:socket(), non_neg_integer(), timeout()) -> {ok, any()}
       | {error, closed | atom()}
  spec recv_proxy_header/2 recv_proxy_header(inet:socket(), timeout()) -> {ok, ranch_proxy_header:proxy_info()}
       | {error, closed | atom()}
       | {error, protocol_error, atom()}
  spec secure/0 secure() -> boolean()
  spec send/2 send(inet:socket(), iodata()) -> ok | {error, atom()}
  spec sendfile/2 sendfile(inet:socket(), file:name_all() | file:fd()) -> {ok, non_neg_integer()}
       | {error, atom()}
  spec sendfile/4 sendfile(inet:socket(), file:name_all() | file:fd(), non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer()) -> {ok, non_neg_integer()}
       | {error, atom()}
  spec sendfile/5 sendfile(inet:socket(), file:name_all() | file:fd(), non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer(), [{chunk_size, non_neg_integer()}]) -> {ok, non_neg_integer()}
       | {error, atom()}
  spec setopts/2 setopts(inet:socket(), list()) -> ok | {error, atom()}
  spec shutdown/2 shutdown(inet:socket(), read | write | read_write) -> ok | {error, atom()}
  spec sockname/1 sockname(inet:socket()) -> {ok, {inet:ip_address(), inet:port_number()} | {local, binary()}}
       | {error, atom()}
  type opt/0 :: {backlog, non_neg_integer()}
       | {buffer, non_neg_integer()}
       | {delay_send, boolean()}
       | {dontroute, boolean()}
       | {exit_on_close, boolean()}
       | {fd, non_neg_integer()}
       | {high_msgq_watermark, non_neg_integer()}
       | {high_watermark, non_neg_integer()}
       | inet
       | inet6
       | {ip, inet:ip_address() | inet:local_address()}
       | {ipv6_v6only, boolean()}
       | {keepalive, boolean()}
       | {linger, {boolean(), non_neg_integer()}}
       | {low_msgq_watermark, non_neg_integer()}
       | {low_watermark, non_neg_integer()}
       | {nodelay, boolean()}
       | {port, inet:port_number()}
       | {priority, integer()}
       | {raw, non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer(), binary()}
       | {recbuf, non_neg_integer()}
       | {send_timeout, timeout()}
       | {send_timeout_close, boolean()}
       | {sndbuf, non_neg_integer()}
       | {tos, integer()}
  type opts/0 :: [opt()]

module ranch_transport
  export sendfile/6
  export_type sendfile_opts/0
  export_type socket/0
  callback accept/2 accept(socket(), timeout()) -> {ok, socket()}
       | {error, closed | timeout | atom()}
  callback cleanup/1 cleanup(ranch:transport_opts(any())) -> ok
  callback close/1 close(socket()) -> ok
  callback connect/3 connect(string(), inet:port_number(), opts()) -> {ok, socket()}
       | {error, atom()}
  callback connect/4 connect(string(), inet:port_number(), opts(), timeout()) -> {ok, socket()}
       | {error, atom()}
  callback controlling_process/2 controlling_process(socket(), pid()) -> ok
       | {error, closed | not_owner | atom()}
  callback format_error/1 format_error(term()) -> string()
  callback getopts/2 getopts(socket(), [atom()]) -> {ok, opts()} | {error, atom()}
  callback getstat/1 getstat(socket()) -> {ok, stats()} | {error, atom()}
  callback getstat/2 getstat(socket(), [atom()]) -> {ok, stats()} | {error, atom()}
  callback handshake/2 handshake(socket(), timeout()) -> {ok, socket()}
       | {ok, socket(), any()}
       | {error, any()}
  callback handshake/3 handshake(socket(), opts(), timeout()) -> {ok, socket()}
       | {ok, socket(), any()}
       | {error, any()}
  callback handshake_cancel/1 handshake_cancel(socket()) -> ok
  callback handshake_continue/2 handshake_continue(socket(), timeout()) -> {ok, socket()} | {error, any()}
  callback handshake_continue/3 handshake_continue(socket(), opts(), timeout()) -> {ok, socket()}
       | {error, any()}
  callback listen/1 listen(ranch:transport_opts(any())) -> {ok, socket()} | {error, atom()}
  callback messages/0 messages() -> {OK::atom(), Closed::atom(), Error::atom(), Passive::atom()}
  callback name/0 name() -> atom()
  callback peername/1 peername(socket()) -> {ok, {inet:ip_address(), inet:port_number()} | {local, binary()}}
       | {error, atom()}
  callback recv/3 recv(socket(), non_neg_integer(), timeout()) -> {ok, any()}
       | {error, closed | timeout | atom()}
  callback recv_proxy_header/2 recv_proxy_header(socket(), timeout()) -> {ok, ranch_proxy_header:proxy_info()}
       | {error, closed | atom()}
       | {error, protocol_error, atom()}
  callback secure/0 secure() -> boolean()
  callback send/2 send(socket(), iodata()) -> ok | {error, atom()}
  callback sendfile/2 sendfile(socket(), file:name_all() | file:fd()) -> {ok, non_neg_integer()}
       | {error, atom()}
  callback sendfile/4 sendfile(socket(), file:name_all() | file:fd(), non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer()) -> {ok, non_neg_integer()}
       | {error, atom()}
  callback sendfile/5 sendfile(socket(), file:name_all() | file:fd(), non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer(), sendfile_opts()) -> {ok, non_neg_integer()}
       | {error, atom()}
  callback setopts/2 setopts(socket(), opts()) -> ok | {error, atom()}
  callback shutdown/2 shutdown(socket(), read | write | read_write) -> ok | {error, atom()}
  callback sockname/1 sockname(socket()) -> {ok, {inet:ip_address(), inet:port_number()} | {local, binary()}}
       | {error, atom()}
  optional_callback format_error/1
  spec chunk_size/1 chunk_size(sendfile_opts()) -> pos_integer()
  spec read_size/3 read_size(non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer()) -> non_neg_integer()
  spec sendfile/6 sendfile(module(), socket(), file:name_all() | file:fd(), non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer(), sendfile_opts()) -> {ok, non_neg_integer()}
       | {error, atom()}
  spec sendfile_loop/6 sendfile_loop(module(), socket(), file:fd(), non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer(), pos_integer()) -> {ok, non_neg_integer()}
       | {error, any()}
  type opts/0 :: any()
  type sendfile_opts/0 :: [{chunk_size, non_neg_integer()}]
  type socket/0 :: any()
  type stats/0 :: any()
